category_title: Children with ASD requiring high structure and emotional regulation support
minimal_context: The class is transitioning to group discussion time, with the children expected to congregate around the teacher on the carpet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our group discussion. Please come congregate on the carpet with the other children.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Opts to sit at his desk) I am staying at my desk.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need everyone together for the discussion. Please find a spot on the carpet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, I dislike the disorder and clutter of sitting with the other children down there.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to join us on the carpet right now so we can start.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Becomes angry) I said no! I am not sitting in that clutter!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our group discussion. Please come congregate on the carpet with the other children.

STUDENT: (Opts to sit at his desk) I am staying at my desk.

TUTOR: We need everyone together for the discussion. Please find a spot on the carpet.

STUDENT: No, I dislike the disorder and clutter of sitting with the other children down there.

TUTOR: You need to join us on the carpet right now so we can start.

STUDENT: (Becomes angry) I said no! I am not sitting in that clutter!

context.environment: Classroom setting during group discussion time
context.materials: Carpet, student desk, chairs arranged in a circle
context.social_setting: Children congregated around the teacher on the carpet, or seated in a circle with the facilitator outside

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When expected to join the other children seated on the carpet for group discussion
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Opted to sit at his desk while the other children congregated around the teacher
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Disliked the disorder and clutter of sitting with the other children on these occasions

behavior_patterns.condition: When faced with changes, for example, in timetabling
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Becomes angry and aggressive with other children and adults
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Shows great difficulty in regulating his emotions generally
